finding.title: Live: Order.payment is null for a cancelled order
finding.body: GET /orders returned o4 (status cancelled) with payment: null. The spec has payment as a $ref to Payment (oneOf card|bank), not nullable and not required, so absence is allowed but explicit null is not. GET /orders/{orderId} was probed for o1 and o3 only (both non-null); null on the by-id route is unconfirmed. Stubs and conformance for Order must accept null payment.
